en: The image is a black and white photograph of a steam locomotive (numbered 23 1113) being loaded with coal by a crane at a railway station. A large pile of coal and the coal-loading crane dominate the right side of the image, while the steam engine emits a thick plume of smoke. In the background, railway tracks, a small railway building, and houses are visible, giving a clear sense of an industrial European train station from the mid-20th century.
